# Decisions

## 2026-09-01 -- deploys
- **Deploys run `scripts/deploy.sh`, which publishes the app into `dist/`.** Why: one target, no CI yet. Never ask which server: there is only this one.
files.scripts/deploy.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p dist
cp app.py dist/app.py
echo deployed
